dedupe_keys.name: semi custom profile for alberta and alberta enterprise and advanced education service regions 2011

description: Three customised 2011 National Household Survey profiles explicitly name place of work and commuting to work. Two cover Alberta enterprise/advanced-education service regions: one uses the first two survey releases and one the final release, with additional income/generation fields. The third covers Canada and designated places for all global non-response rates. Broader demographic topics remain outside the transport claim. All list IVT tables requiring Beyond 20/20, plus installer/guide links. Mode shares, flows, distances and exact commuting variables are unstated. These distinct releases/geographies are curated companions, without assuming equal populations or seamless coverage. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the original source identity and metadata. Source coverage is Alberta unless the described component explicitly includes Canada. The native licence field states Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs are unverified. No linked dataset, document, workbook, archive, installer, code or legal text was fetched. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown.
